newsitem.title: USA: Fuji Photo buys Genovese photo lab.
newsitem.headline: Fuji Photo buys Genovese photo lab.

text.p: Fuji Photo Film U.S.A., a unit of Fuji Photo Film Co, and Genovese Drug Stores Inc said Friday that Fujifilm has reached an agreement to acquire Genovese's Living Color photofinishing lab located in Glen Cove, NY. Terms of the agreement were not disclosed.
The lab will provide wholesale photofinishing services to the Genovese Drug Store chain as well as to other Fuji TruColor customers.

The companies also said they have entered into an arrangement whereby Fuji Photo Film will supply minilabs, color paper and chemistry to Genovese in addition to wholesale photofinishing. Terms of the supply arrangement were also not disclosed.
With this acquisition, Fujifilm now operates 23 wholesale photofinishing laboratories throughout the United States.
Genovese is a retail drug chain in the metropolitan New York City area, operating 127 stores.
